claim: The interrupt lands on the same video line each frame, so line-clock readings a frame apart differ by 0 or 311; add a frame when the lines since the last read are under half of one.

evidence.text: The interrupt lands on the same video line, so lines since the last read are 0 mod 311 at each interrupt.
Two line readings a frame apart differ by 0 or 311 (jitter).
